observations: Photo 0 shows a Canon lens with visible text 'EFS 18-55mm' and 'IS' and 'AF/MF'.
Photo 1 shows the rear cap area; no clear lens mount details beyond the Canon branding on the cap.
Photo 2 shows the front cap area; no clear front glass condition (no close-up of elements).
No photo shows shutter count, battery, charger, or any fungus/scratch on the lens glass.

claims.claim: UK used Lens are available in our shop
claims.evidence: No UK origin paperwork or markings shown in the photos.
Photos show only a lens; no camera body or shutter count screen/EXIF.

claims.claim: no fungus or scratch on the lens
claims.evidence: No close-up of the lens glass/elements; photos mainly show the outside with caps.

claims.claim: Original battery and charger, never repaired.

risks.risk: Lens glass condition (fungus, haze, scratches) not verifiable from the provided angles/caps.
risks.proof: A clear close-up photo of the front and rear lens elements (no cap), taken under light at multiple angles.
risks.if_unproven: Price as lens with unknown internal condition (worst case: treat as not confirmed clean).

risks.risk: Whether the lens is actually the Canon EFS 18-55mm IS (and which version) and whether autofocus/IS works.
risks.proof: A short video showing autofocus lock on a subject and IS stabilization (handheld shake test) plus a photo of the lens label/serial and mount contacts.
risks.if_unproven: Price as not confirmed working (worst case: treat as not working/untested).

risks.risk: Compatibility/mount uncertainty (EFS is typically Canon APS-C; may not fit full-frame).
risks.proof: Photo of the mount side showing the exact mount type and a quick fit test on the seller’s camera body.

risks.risk: Seller may be mixing claims about camera shutter count/battery with a lens listing.
risks.proof: Photo of the camera body used (if any) and the shutter count screen; otherwise confirm this is lens-only sale.
risks.if_unproven: Price as lens-only, ignoring camera/battery claims.

proof_requests: Send close-up photos of the front and rear lens elements (no caps) showing any fungus/scratches/haze.
Send a short video: autofocus working + IS working (if present) and a focus ring movement check.
Send a photo of the lens mount side and the full lens label/serial number.
Confirm clearly: is this a lens-only sale (no camera body, no battery, no charger)?
response.reason: The photos clearly identify a Canon EFS 18-55mm IS lens, but the key claims that affect value (lens glass condition, IS/autofocus working, and any shutter/battery details) are not verifiable from the provided images.
